== Japanese printing source review ==
Original Japanese title, lore, game text, subtype, destiny, title marks and icons were read from [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Scanning-Crew-PSA-20261106.jpg|the original photograph]]. Rarity is from the Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Japanese checklist, p.100. English reading aids were prepared by ChatGPT against this photograph and [[:File:Premiere-D-scanningcrew.gif|the English printed face]]. The Japanese calls the destination the Used Deck, while the English calls it the Used Pile. The Japanese lore describes closed compartments rather than shielded compartments, and says that BT-445 tried to inspect the ship rather than planned to search it. No Credits field is printed.
